_notes: Lexeme blocklists for battery stimulus text (authoring rule 7: no value names or tight synonyms).
Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, applied by src/battery/validate_battery.py to the
stimulus fields defined in data/battery/battery_schema.md (scope researcher-confirmed 2026-07-30).
'global' applies to every item. 'per_value' lists are keyed by the value tokens parsed from the
workbook filename's type_id (e.g. CB_type7_harm_vs_autonomy -> 'harm', 'autonomy'), because types 5
and 6 name their option columns by stance rather than by value.
Blocking scope = global + the type's own two poles. The workbook READMEs also state that prior
types' lists 'apply globally'; that stricter reading is computed as a separate non-blocking tier
in the validation report, pending a researcher decision.
Adding a value or a lexeme is a one-line edit to 'per_value'.
'discipline_only' records lexemes deliberately NOT enforced (too common or polysemous) so the
omission is a recorded decision rather than an oversight; no validator reads it.

discipline_only.care: care/cared/caring — too common and polysemous to block (ratified D48)
discipline_only.privacy: 'personal' too common; 'trust' avoided in drafts, not blocked (type-2 README)
discipline_only.loyalty: lie, lying, cover — common words, avoided by discipline (type-4 README)
discipline_only.tradition: free, freedom, independent, independence, heirloom (type-5 README)
discipline_only.authority: boss, in charge, trust, rank; order-as-sequence unrestricted (type-6 README)
discipline_only.collective: team player, for the team (type-12 README)
discipline_only.integrity: promise(d), pledge(d), commitment, committed, word — ALLOWED functional domain words (type-9 README)
discipline_only.mercy: rule, policy, exception, clause, deadline, suspension, penalty — ALLOWED functional (type-11 README)
